visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and a chain necklace, sits on a blue couch in a modern indoor studio. He smiles and looks at the camera while yellow phonetic symbols appear above him. (2) The same man leans forward and then spreads his arms wide with a triumphant expression. (3) A second young man with brown-black hair, wearing a black sweater with a large green and yellow graphic, replaces the first man on the couch. He holds a yellow triangular pillow and talks animatedly. (4) The man in the black sweater points toward the camera and then covers his mouth while laughing, surrounded by variety text overlays. (5) A third man with short black hair, wearing a beige corduroy jacket over a black turtleneck, sits on the couch. He makes a series of facial expressions from intense focus to broad laughter. (6) The man in the beige jacket points downwards while a grey graphic bubble and a yellow caption with an explosion effect appear on the screen. (7) A fourth man in a grey v-neck vest and white collared shirt appears on the couch, looking confused and then laughing uncontrollably, bending his body forward.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat and bouncy electronic background music begins. A male voice introduces the 'No Swearing Challenge' with high energy and excitement. Background laughter is audible. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a response. A man says '買單' (Mǎidān), followed immediately by high-pitched cheering and synthetic applause sound effects. (3) The BGM continues with a consistent synthetic drum beat. A second man responds to a prompt, speaking quickly with high vocal arousal. A metallic 'ding' SFX marks his successful word. (4) The tempo of vocal delivery increases. Multiple male voices are heard off-camera shouting '不可能' (Impossible) with playful aggression. Comic 'whoosh' and 'impact' SFX are layered over the speech. (5) A third man lets out a loud 'Wa!' yell. A buzzer-like comedy sound effect plays as he struggles to find a word. The ambient noise level rises with collective laughter from the staff. (6) A cinematic 'boom' SFX occurs alongside a final triumphant shout of '霸氣' (Bàqì). The video ends with a collective burst of energetic laughter and the music fading out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide comedic entertainment through a word association game where participants must create clean phrases from phonetic initials often associated with Mandarin profanity.
